set.body:
Outcome
Deliver a coherent AtlantaFX-derived native desktop system and prove its ScalaDock and scientific-application integration.

Owned scope
PLAN.md; meridian-theme; meridian-workbench; meridian-scaladock; meridian-sampler

Prerequisites
E0, E1, E2, E3, P

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All required phase epics E0–E3 are closed with their acceptance evidence; no unresolved release-blocking defects remain.
- [ ] Native light/dark × comfortable/compact specimens, behavior/accessibility, scientific isolation, performance, and exact-artifact consumers pass the declared gates.
- [ ] ScalaDock provider work is accepted through B0 against an exact provider revision; local planning or a provider issue status alone is not consumer proof.
- [ ] README and compatibility documentation describe only observed support; Windows remains unqualified unless separately evidenced. Publication is outside this epic's authority.

Required evidence
Final D7 readout, native evidence index, consumer receipts, dependency closure and notices.

Completion rule
Record exact candidate/revisions, commands and exit status, retained evidence paths, and applicable limitations. No unrun checks or browser-only captures establish native correctness. Keep provider/app ownership in its own tracker. Implementers reserve exact paths before editing; shared source files have one writer. Use review until the stated reviewer/gate accepts.

Plan
PLAN.md — acceptance backlog code R. Mote is authoritative for status and dependencies.
